procedures.name: ShowPriceListLines
procedures.doc: Displays price list lines for this general ledger account filtered by price type and amount type.

procedures.name: SetupNewGLAcc
procedures.doc: Initializes a new general ledger account with default values based on an existing account. Copies income/balance classification and other relevant setup from the reference account.

procedures.name: CheckGLAcc
procedures.doc: Validates that the general ledger account is ready for posting transactions. Checks that account type is Posting and account is not blocked.

procedures.name: ValidateAccountSubCategory
procedures.doc: Validates and sets the account subcategory based on text input from user interface. Matches input text against available subcategory descriptions for the account category.

procedures.name: LookupAccountSubCategory
procedures.doc: Opens a lookup page for selecting account subcategory based on the account's income/balance type and category. Updates the account category and subcategory based on user selection.

procedures.name: GetCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Returns the additional reporting currency code from General Ledger Setup. Used for additional currency amount formatting in flowfields.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Validates and updates the shortcut dimension code for the specified dimension field. Saves the dimension value as a default dimension for this account.

procedures.name: TranslationMethodConflict
procedures.doc: Checks for consolidation translation method conflicts with other accounts using same consolidation accounts. Prevents inconsistent translation methods for accounts that consolidate to the same target account.

procedures.name: CheckGenProdPostingGroup
procedures.doc: Validates that the general product posting group is specified for the account. Logs an error message if the posting group is missing for posting-type accounts.

procedures.name: IsTotaling
procedures.doc: Determines whether the account type supports totaling functionality. Returns true for Total and End-Total account types used in account hierarchies.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckGLAcc
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating that a general ledger account is ready for posting. Allows extensions to add custom validation logic for account posting readiness.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetupNewGLAcc
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting up a new general ledger account with default values. Allows extensions to add custom initialization logic for new accounts.

procedures.name: OnAfterValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating and updating shortcut dimension codes. Allows extensions to perform additional processing after dimension validation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating shortcut dimension codes. Allows extensions to modify validation logic or skip default validation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckGenProdPostingGroup
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking general product posting group requirements. Allows extensions to override or supplement posting group validation logic.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOnDelete
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before deleting a general ledger account. Allows extensions to perform custom validation or cleanup before account deletion.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckSalesOrdersPrepmtToDeduct
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking sales orders with prepayments to deduct. Allows extensions to override or supplement prepayment validation logic for sales orders.

procedures.doc: Opens the Customer Ledger Entries page filtered to show only overdue entries.

procedures.doc: Gets the adjusted currency factor, returning 1 if not set.

procedures.doc: Opens the Dimension Set Entries page showing the dimensions for this entry.

procedures.doc: Determines the visual style for displaying this entry based on its payment status.

procedures.name: SetApplyToFilters
procedures.doc: Sets filters on the record to show entries that can be applied based on the specified criteria.

procedures.name: SetAmountToApply
procedures.doc: Toggles the Amount to Apply field between the remaining amount and zero for the specified document.

procedures.name: CopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Copies field values from a general journal line to this customer ledger entry.

procedures.name: CopyFromCVLedgEntryBuffer
procedures.doc: Copies field values from a CV ledger entry buffer to this customer ledger entry.

procedures.name: RecalculateAmounts
procedures.doc: Recalculates amount fields from one currency to another using exchange rates at the specified posting date.

procedures.name: UpdateAmountsForApplication
procedures.doc: Updates amount fields for application by converting to the application currency.

procedures.name: GetRemainingPmtDiscPossible
procedures.doc: Gets the remaining payment discount possible, allowing for customization through events.

procedures.name: InitInsert
procedures.doc: Initializes a new sales header with a new document number from the number series.

procedures.name: InitRecord
procedures.doc: Initializes a new sales header with default values.

procedures.name: InitPostingDescription
procedures.doc: Initializes the posting description with formatted document type and number text for the sales header.

procedures.name: SetStandardCodesMgt
procedures.doc: Sets global StandardCodesMgtGlobal codeunit to a new instance.

procedures.name: AssistEdit
procedures.doc: Opens a page to select related number series for the sales header and updates the document number with the selected number series.

procedures.name: TestNoSeries
procedures.doc: Checks if the number series for different types of sales documents are filled in the sales setup.

procedures.name: GetNoSeriesCode
procedures.doc: Returns the number series code from the sales setup based on the document type of the sales header.

procedures.name: TestNoSeriesDate
procedures.doc: Checks if the number series has to be assigned chronologically after various documents are already posted.

procedures.name: ConfirmDeletion
procedures.doc: Opens a confirmation dialog to confirm the deletion of the sales header. This check is to confirm with the user that gaps will happen in the posted documents if the document is deleted.

procedures.name: GetCust
procedures.doc: Updates the global Customer record. Record will not be retrieved if document type is quote and provided customer no is blank.

procedures.name: SalesLinesExist
procedures.doc: Checks if any sales lines exists for sales header.

procedures.name: RecreateSalesLines
procedures.doc: Recreates sales lines for a sales document when the provided field in the sales header is changed.

procedures.name: StoreSalesCommentLineToTemp
procedures.doc: Inserts existing sales comment lines into a temporary record.

procedures.name: RestoreSalesCommentLine
procedures.doc: Inserts sales comment lines for the sales line of the document. Lines are inserted from the provided temporary sales comment line record set.

procedures.name: MessageIfSalesLinesExist
procedures.doc: Displays a message if sales lines exist for the sales header and the changed field was not updated on the lines.

procedures.name: PriceMessageIfSalesLinesExist
procedures.doc: Displays a message to the user if there are existing sales lines and a provided field in the sales header has been changed, which might affect the prices and discounts on the sales lines.

procedures.name: UpdateCurrencyFactor
procedures.doc: Updates currency factor on the sales header and recreates sales lines if the currency code has changed.

procedures.name: ConfirmCurrencyFactorUpdate
procedures.doc: Updates currency factor on the sales header if confirmed by the user.

procedures.name: SetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global flag HideValidationDialog.

procedures.name: GetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global flag HideValidationDialog.

procedures.name: SetHideCreditCheckDialogue
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global flag HideCreditCheckDialogue.

procedures.name: GetHideCreditCheckDialogue
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global flag HideCreditCheckDialogue.

procedures.name: UpdateLocationCode
procedures.doc: Updates the location code with the specified location code. If it's empty, it takes location code from user setup management.

procedures.name: UpdateSalesLines
procedures.doc: Updates sales lines to reflect changes in the sales header field. Optionally the confirmation is raised, for the user to confirm the update of lines.

procedures.name: UpdateSalesLinesByFieldNo
procedures.doc: Updates sales lines based on the provided field number.

procedures.name: ConfirmReservationDateConflict
procedures.doc: Raises a confirmation informing the user that reservations may be canceled if the change in the field causes a date conflict. Confirmation is only raised if reservations exist. If not confirmed, the execution stops.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates and assigns dimensions for the sales header based on the provided default dimension sources.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Verifies whether the provided shortcut dimension code and value are valid. If valid, assigns it to the sales document.

procedures.name: ShippedSalesLinesExist
procedures.doc: Determines if sales lines that are already shipped exist.

procedures.name: ReturnReceiptExist
procedures.doc: Determines if sales lines that are already returned exist.

procedures.name: DeleteAllSalesLines
procedures.doc: Deletes all sales lines, reservation, and comment lines for the document.

procedures.name: CheckCustomerCreated
procedures.doc: Checks if sell-to and bill-to customer numbers are filled. If not, it creates customers based on the associated contact and customer template, and assigns the new customer number to the document.

procedures.name: RecreateReqLine
procedures.doc: Recreates requisition lines linked to a sales line, either shifting them to a temporary table or back based on the provided ToTemp flag, updating the order promising line ID in the process.

procedures.name: TestPostingDate
procedures.doc: Validates that the posting date matches the work date when posting date check is enabled in sales setup.

procedures.name: UpdateSellToCont
procedures.doc: Updates the sell-to contact details of a sales header based on the provided customer number.

procedures.name: UpdateBillToCont
procedures.doc: Updates the bill-to contact details of a sales header based on the provided customer number.

procedures.name: UpdateSellToCust
procedures.doc: Updates the sell-to customer details of a sales header based on the provided contact number.

procedures.name: GetShippingTime
procedures.doc: Updates the shipping time on the sales header.

procedures.name: GetSellToCustomerFaxNo
procedures.doc: Gets sell-to customer fax number.

procedures.name: CheckCreditMaxBeforeInsert
procedures.doc: Checks the bill to customer credit limit and if credit limit is exceeded, creates a notification.

procedures.name: CreateInvtPutAwayPick
procedures.doc: Creates inventory put-away, pick, or movement documents for a released sales document.

procedures.name: CreateTask
procedures.doc: Starts the create task wizard with information from the sales header.

procedures.name: UpdateShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Updates the ship-to address information if the sales header has a credit document type.

procedures.name: ShowDocDim
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing dimensions for the sales header. If dimensions are changed, they're updated on the sales lines as well.

procedures.name: UpdateAllLineDim
procedures.doc: Updates the dimensions of sales lines in a sales document when the dimensions of the sales header are changed.

procedures.name: LookupAdjmtValueEntries
procedures.doc: Opens a page with adjustment value entries related to the sales header.

procedures.name: GetCustomerVATRegistrationNumber
procedures.doc: Returns the VAT registration number from a sales header.

procedures.name: GetCustomerVATRegistrationNumberLbl
procedures.doc: Returns the VAT registration number field caption from a sales header.

procedures.name: GetStatusStyleText
procedures.doc: Returns customer global location number. Currently defined to return an empty value.

procedures.name: GetPstdDocLinesToReverse
procedures.doc: Opens a page with posted document lines that can be reversed. After the user selects the lines, they are copied to the current document.

procedures.name: CalcInvDiscForHeader
procedures.doc: Calculates invoice discount for a sales header if calculate invoice discount is enabled in the sales setup.

procedures.name: SetSecurityFilterOnRespCenter
procedures.doc: Filters the sales header for responsibility center set in the user setup or company information. The filter is set in filter group 2 and is hidden from the user.

procedures.name: SynchronizeForReservations
procedures.doc: Updates reservations data if location or bin have changed on the sales line.

procedures.name: InventoryPickConflict
procedures.doc: Determines if there is a conflict between inventory pick and sales line for a given sales document.

procedures.name: WhseShipmentConflict
procedures.doc: Determines if there is a conflict between warehouse shipment and sales line for a given sales document.

procedures.name: CheckItemAvailabilityInLines
procedures.doc: Checks if all lines of the document are in stock. If the quantity in stock is too low, a notification is shown.

procedures.name: QtyToShipIsZero
procedures.doc: Determines if the quantity to ship is zero for all sales document lines.

procedures.name: IsApprovedForPosting
procedures.doc: Checks if the sales document can be posted. It checks for status, approvals, payments and prepayments, and throws an error if conditions are not met.

procedures.name: IsApprovedForPostingBatch
procedures.doc: Determines if the sales document can be posted. It checks for status, approvals, payments, and prepayments.

procedures.name: GetLegalStatement
procedures.doc: Returns legal statement from sales setup. Currently defined to return an empty value.

procedures.name: SendToPosting
procedures.doc: Posts a sales document by running the provided codeunit if the document is approved for posting.

procedures.name: CancelBackgroundPosting
procedures.doc: Cancels a background posting job for a sales document.

procedures.name: EmailRecords
procedures.doc: Sends an email with the sales document attached.

procedures.name: GetDocTypeTxt
procedures.doc: Retrieves the full document type name based on the sales header document type.

procedures.name: GetFullDocTypeTxt
procedures.doc: Retrieves the full sales document type name based on the sales header document type.

procedures.name: LinkSalesDocWithOpportunity
procedures.doc: Updates the link between the sales document and an opportunity.

procedures.name: SynchronizeAsmHeader
procedures.doc: Updates the posting date of related assembly headers with the sales header.

procedures.name: CheckShippingAdvice
procedures.doc: Checks if the sales document can be shipped completely and throws an error if it cannot.

procedures.name: GetContactAsCompany
procedures.doc: Retrieves the company contact associated with the provided contact.

procedures.name: InvoicedLineExists
procedures.doc: Determines whether there are invoiced sales lines for the sales header.

procedures.name: CreateDimSetForPrepmtAccDefaultDim
procedures.doc: Updates dimensions on lines with prepayments.

procedures.name: PrepareOpeningDocumentStatistics
procedures.doc: Runs checks and prepares data needed to open the document statistics page.

procedures.doc: Triggers the OnCheckSalesPostRestrictions event that allows customized restrictions to be added to the sales document post process.

procedures.doc: Opens a page to either select an existing payment service or set up a new one if none exists. The payment service is then assigned to the document.

procedures.name: InitOutstanding
procedures.doc: Updates outstanding quantities and amounts to reflect changes in posted quantities and amounts.

procedures.name: InitOutstandingAmount
procedures.doc: Updates outstanding amounts to reflect changes in quantity.

procedures.name: InitQtyToShip
procedures.doc: Updates quantity to ship and quantity to invoice based on the outstanding quantities

procedures.name: InitQtyToReceive
procedures.doc: Updates quantity to receive and quantity to invoice based on the outstanding quantity and document type.

procedures.name: InitQtyToInvoice
procedures.doc: Prepares the sales line for the next invoice posting by setting the quantities and amounts to be invoiced.

procedures.name: MaxQtyToInvoice
procedures.doc: Determines the maximum quantity that can be invoiced for the current sales line.

procedures.name: MaxQtyToInvoiceBase
procedures.doc: Determines the maximum quantity (base) that can be invoiced for the current sales line.

procedures.name: MaxQtyToShipBase
procedures.doc: Ensures that the quantity to ship does not exceed the outstanding quantity.

procedures.name: CalcLineAmount
procedures.doc: Calculates the net line amount after applying the invoice discount.

procedures.name: CalcShipmentDateForLocation
procedures.doc: Updates the shipment date based on the location's customized calendar.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesLine
procedures.doc: Copies values from a specified sales line to the current sales line.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesShptLine
procedures.doc: Copies values from a specified sales shipment line to the current sales line.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesInvLine
procedures.doc: Copies values from a specified sales invoice line to the current sales line.

procedures.name: CopyFromReturnRcptLine
procedures.doc: Copies values from a specified return receipt line to the current sales line.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesCrMemoLine
procedures.doc: Copies values from a specified sales cr. memo line to the current sales line.

procedures.name: GetSkipTaxCalculation
procedures.doc: Returns the value of global SkipTaxCalculation flag. The flag is unused in the object.

procedures.name: SetSkipTaxCalulation
procedures.doc: Sets the value of global SkipTaxCalculation flag. The flag is unused in the object.

procedures.name: SetSalesHeader
procedures.doc: Updates the global SalesHeader variable and initializes the currency based on the new sales header.

procedures.name: SetSuppressSalesHeaderExistsVerification
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the SuppressSalesHeaderExistsVerification variable.

procedures.name: GetSalesHeader
procedures.doc: Gets the sales header associated with the sales line. Ensures the global SalesHeader variable is correctly set.

procedures.name: GetSalesHeader
procedures.doc: Gets the sales header and the currency associated with the sales line. Ensures that the global SalesHeader variable and the currency are correctly set.

procedures.name: GetItem
procedures.doc: Gets the item record from the item number on the sales line.

procedures.name: GetItem
procedures.doc: Gets the item record from the the item number on the sales line.

procedures.name: GetResource
procedures.doc: Gets the resource record from the resource number on the sales line. The global Resource variable is updated with the retrieved resource.

procedures.name: GetRemainingQty
procedures.doc: Calculates the quantity and quantity (base) that remain unreserved on the sales line.

procedures.name: GetReservationQty
procedures.doc: Gets the quantities related to reservations for the sales line.

procedures.name: GetSourceCaption
procedures.doc: Returns a caption containing the document type, document number and line number separated by spaces for the sales line.

procedures.name: SetReservationEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes the reservation entry with information from the sales line.

procedures.name: SetReservationFilters
procedures.doc: Filters the reservation entries for the sales line.

procedures.name: ReservEntryExist
procedures.doc: Checks if a reservation entry exists for the sales line.

procedures.name: IsPriceCalcCalledByField
procedures.doc: Checks if the price calculation was triggered by a specific field.

procedures.name: PlanPriceCalcByField
procedures.doc: Plans for a price calculation triggered by a specific field, ensuring that the calculation is performed only once.

procedures.name: ClearFieldCausedPriceCalculation
procedures.doc: Resets the tracking of the field that is planned to trigger a price calculation.

procedures.name: UpdateUnitPrice
procedures.doc: Updates the unit price on the sales line.

procedures.name: UpdateUnitPriceByField
procedures.doc: Updates the unit price on the sales line. The calculation is only performed if the field number of the field that triggered the price calculation is the same as the planned field no.

procedures.name: CopyUnitPriceAndLineDiscountPct
procedures.doc: Copies the unit price and line discount percentage from a blanket order sales line to this line.

procedures.name: ShowUnitPriceChangedMsg
procedures.doc: Displays a message when the unit price has changed for a credit document line copied from a posted document.

procedures.name: GetPriceCalculationHandler
procedures.doc: Gets the "Price Calculation" implementation for the sales line.

procedures.name: GetLineWithPrice
procedures.doc: Returns a default "Line With Price" implementation if not overridden.

procedures.name: ApplyDiscount
procedures.doc: Applies the discount and assigns the calculated amount to the sales line.

procedures.name: ApplyPrice
procedures.doc: Applies the price and assigns the calculated amount to the sales line.

procedures.name: CountDiscount
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method CountDiscount. Returns the number of price list lines with discounts that fit the sales line.

procedures.name: CountPrice
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method CountPrice. Returns the number of price list lines with prices that fit the sales line.

procedures.name: DiscountExists
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method DiscountExists. Returns true if any price list line with discount that fit the sales line exist.

procedures.name: PriceExists
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method PriceExists. Returns true if any price list line with price or cost that fit the sales line exist.

procedures.name: PickDiscount
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method PickDiscount. Opens a price list selection to pick from lines with discount that fit the sales line. After the selection the amounts are assigned to the sales line.

procedures.name: PickPrice
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method PickPrice. Opens a price list selection to pick from lines with price or cost that fit the sales line. After the selection the amounts are assigned to the sales line.

procedures.name: UpdateReferencePriceAndDiscount
procedures.doc: Applies the discount and price for "Item Reference No." field and assigns the calculated amount to the sales line.

procedures.name: FindResUnitCost
procedures.doc: Finds and applies the unit cost for a resource line based on the resource cost setup.

procedures.name: FindResUnitCostOnAfterInitResCost
procedures.doc: Raises the OnFindResUnitCostOnAfterInitResCost event after the resource cost record is initialized.

procedures.name: AfterFindResUnitCost
procedures.doc: Raises the OnAfterFindResUnitCost event after the resource unit cost is found.

procedures.name: UpdatePrepmtSetupFields
procedures.doc: Updates the prepayment VAT fields on the sales line based on the VAT posting setup to account for updates on the prepayment sales line.

procedures.name: UpdatePrepmtAmounts
procedures.doc: Updates the prepayment amounts on the sales line to reflect changes in the outstanding amount.

procedures.name: CalculateOutstandingAmountExclTax
procedures.doc: Calculates the outstanding amount excluding tax for the sales line.

procedures.name: CheckPrepmtAmounts
procedures.doc: Validates that the prepayment amounts are consistent with the line amounts and invoiced amounts.

procedures.name: ThrowWrongAmountError
procedures.doc: Raises an error when the prepayment line amount is less than the prepayment amount invoiced.

procedures.name: UpdateAmounts
procedures.doc: Updates line, prepayment, deferral, and VAT amounts for the sales line to account for any changes of the sales line that affect the amounts.

procedures.name: UpdateVATAmounts
procedures.doc: Updates the VAT amounts on the sales line based on the VAT calculation type and other line details to reflect changes in fields that affect them, like line amount, VAT %, and others.

procedures.name: CheckItemAvailable
procedures.doc: Verifies the availability of the item on the shipment date. If the item is not available, a notification is shown and an error is raised to stop the update.

procedures.name: ShowOrderTracking
procedures.doc: Opens a Order Tracking summary page for the current sales line.

procedures.name: ShowReservation
procedures.doc: Opens a reservation summary page for the current sales line. After the page closes, updates the planned status of the line.

procedures.name: ShowReservationEntries
procedures.doc: Opens a reservation entries page for the current sales line.

procedures.name: AutoReserve
procedures.doc: Attempts to automatically reserve the quantity of the current sales line based on the item availability. If the quantity cannot be reserved automatically, a message is shown and the user is prompted to reserve manually.

procedures.name: AutoReserve
procedures.doc: Attempts to automatically reserve the quantity of the current sales line based on the item availability.

procedures.name: AutoAsmToOrder
procedures.doc: Creates or updates the assembly order associated with the sales line to reflect the current line details.

procedures.name: GetDate
procedures.doc: Retrieves the date to be used for operations on the sales line, which is the associated sales header's posting date or the work date if the posting date is not set.

procedures.name: CalcPlannedDeliveryDate
procedures.doc: Calculates the planned delivery date based on the shipping agent, planned shipment date and the field that initiated the calculation.

procedures.name: CheckCustomerBaseCalendarCodeExist
procedures.doc: Checks whether the sell-to customer has a base calendar code assigned.

procedures.name: CalcPlannedShptDate
procedures.doc: Calculates the planned shipment date based on the shipping agent and the field that initiated the calculation.

procedures.name: CalcShipmentDate
procedures.doc: Calculates the shipment date based on the shipping agent, location and planned shipment date.

procedures.name: SignedXX
procedures.doc: Adjusts the sign of the provided value based on the document type of the sales line.

procedures.name: ShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing dimensions for the sale line. After the page closes, updates the dimensions on the sales line and assembly orders.

procedures.name: OpenItemTrackingLines
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing item tracking lines for the sale line.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Initializes dimensions on the sales line for the provided list of default dimension sources.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Checks if the provided shortcut dimension code and value are valid.

procedures.name: LookupShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Opens a page for looking up a shortcut dimension code value.

procedures.name: ShowShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Gets an array of shortcut dimension values from the dimensions of the sales line.

procedures.name: SelectMultipleItems
procedures.doc: Opens a page for selecting multiple items to add to the document. Selected items are added to the document.

procedures.name: AddItems
procedures.doc: Adds items to the document based on the provided selection filter.

procedures.name: AddItem
procedures.doc: Adds an item to the document.

procedures.name: ProcessSalesLine
procedures.doc: Creates or updates assembly orders if assemble-to-order is required. Creates extended text lines applicable to the provided sales line.

procedures.name: InitNewLine
procedures.doc: Initializes a new sales line based on the current sales line.

procedures.name: ShowItemSub
procedures.doc: Opens a page for looking up item substitutions for the current item on the sales line. If substitution is selected, the item is replaced with the selected item.

procedures.name: ShowNonstock
procedures.doc: Opens a page for selecting a nonstock item to add to the document. If a nonstock item is selected, it is added to the document and the unit price is updated.

procedures.name: GetFAPostingGroup
procedures.doc: Sets tax and posting groups codes for a fixed asset sales line.

procedures.name: GetCaptionClass
procedures.doc: Gets a caption class for a field.

procedures.name: GetSKU
procedures.doc: Gets a stockkeeping unit for the current sales line and saves it in a global variable SKU.

procedures.name: GetSKU
procedures.doc: Gets a stockkeeping unit for the current sales line.

procedures.name: GetUnitCost
procedures.doc: Finds and assigns the unit cost for the item specified on the sales line.

procedures.name: ShowItemChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing item charge assignment for the item charge sales line. If assignments don't exist for the item charge, new assignments are created and committed before opening the page.

procedures.name: UpdateItemChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Updates amounts on item charge assignments for the current sales line.

procedures.name: DeleteItemChargeAssignment
procedures.doc: Deletes item charge assignments applied to a sales document line.

procedures.name: DeleteChargeChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Deletes item charge assignments associated with a sales line.

procedures.name: TestStatusOpen
procedures.doc: Tests if sales header of the line is open.

procedures.name: GetSuspendedStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global variable StatusCheckSuspended.

procedures.name: SuspendStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable StatusCheckSuspended.

procedures.name: SwitchLinesWithErrorsFilter
procedures.doc: Toggles the filter for lines with errors between displaying all lines and only lines with errors.

procedures.name: UpdateVATOnLines
procedures.doc: Recalculates and updates line and VAT amounts on all lines of the document.

procedures.name: CalcVATAmountLines
procedures.doc: Creates VAT amount lines for all applicable sales lines in the document. An overload that sets IncludePrepayments to true.

procedures.name: CalcVATAmountLines
procedures.doc: Creates VAT amount lines for all applicable sales lines in the document.

procedures.name: GetCPGInvRoundAcc
procedures.doc: Gets the account number to use for invoice rounding from the customer posting group. If invoice rounding is disabled, returns blank

procedures.name: GetVATAmountLineOfMaxAmt
procedures.doc: Gets the VAT amount line for the sales line with the maximum absolute amount from the VAT amount line set.

procedures.name: CalcInvDiscToInvoice
procedures.doc: Updates the invoice discount amount to invoice based on the current quantity and quantity to invoice.

procedures.name: UpdateWithWarehouseShip
procedures.doc: Updates the quantities to ship or receive based on the document type, quantity, and location/warehouse requirements.

procedures.name: CheckWarehouse
procedures.doc: Checks that the warehouse requirements for the sales line, such as shipment, pick, receive, and put-away are met based on the location and document type.

procedures.name: CheckWarehouseForQtyToShip
procedures.doc: Checks the warehouse requirements for the quantity to be shipped.

procedures.name: UpdateDates
procedures.doc: Updates the shipment and delivery dates for the sales line.

procedures.name: GetItemTranslation
procedures.doc: Retrieves the item translation for the language of the document and updates the descriptions on the sales line.

procedures.name: PriceExists
procedures.doc: Returns true if any price list line with price or cost that fit the sales line exist. This is an overload that sets ShowAll to true.

procedures.name: LineDiscExists
procedures.doc: Returns true if any price list line with discount that fit the sales line exist. This is an overload that sets ShowAll to true.

procedures.name: RowID1
procedures.doc: Creates a unique row identifier for the sales line used for item tracking.

procedures.name: GetDefaultBin
procedures.doc: Gets the default bin for the sales line item based on the requriments of the location.

procedures.name: GetATOBin
procedures.doc: Retrieves the Assembly-to-Order (ATO) bin for a given location.

procedures.name: IsInbound
procedures.doc: Determines if the sales document this line belongs to is an inbound document.

procedures.name: CheckAssocPurchOrder
procedures.doc: Raises an error if the sales line is associated with a purchase order to ensure no changes are made to the line.

procedures.name: CheckServItemCreation
procedures.doc: Ensures that items that create a service item are not shipped in fractional quantities.

procedures.name: ItemExists
procedures.doc: Determines if the provided item number exists.

procedures.name: FindOrCreateRecordByNo
procedures.doc: Finds or creates a record by a given number and returns the number of the found

procedures.name: IsShipment
procedures.doc: Determines if the sales line represents a shipment.

procedures.name: GetAbsMin
procedures.doc: Retrieves the absolute minimum between the quantity to handle and the quantity handled.

procedures.name: SetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Sets the global HideValidationDialog flag.

procedures.name: GetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Gets the global HideValidationDialog flag.

procedures.name: CalcPrepaymentToDeduct
procedures.doc: Updates the prepayment amount to deduct with the next posting.

procedures.name: IsFinalInvoice
procedures.doc: Determines if the line will be fully invoiced after posting.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountToHandle
procedures.doc: Calculates the net line amount for the specified quantity to handle.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountToHandleInclPrepmt
procedures.doc: Calculates the net line amount for the specified quantity to handle. If line must be fully prepaid then the line amount is calculated with the prepayment amount to deduct.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountExclVAT
procedures.doc: Calculates the line amount excluding VAT.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountInclVAT
procedures.doc: Calculates the line amount including VAT.

procedures.name: SetHasBeenShown
procedures.doc: Sets a flag to prevent showing a message if shipment date is before work date.

procedures.name: TestJobPlanningLine
procedures.doc: Ensures that a sales line that is associated with a job task has not been changed.

procedures.name: BlockDynamicTracking
procedures.doc: Sets the blocking state for dynamic tracking of reservations on quantity change.

procedures.name: InitQtyToShip2
procedures.doc: Initializes the quantity to ship and invoice to reflect changes after the sales line has been (partially) posted. Additionally, reclaculates the proportional invoice discount and prepayment amounts for next posting.

procedures.name: ShowLineComments
procedures.doc: Opens a page to show comments for the sales line.

procedures.name: SetDefaultQuantity
procedures.doc: Resets quantities to ship/return and invoice to zero based on the sales setup setting for default shipping quantity.

procedures.name: SetReserveWithoutPurchasingCode
procedures.doc: Sets the reservation method for the sales line from the item. If item's reservation method is optional, the sales header's reservation method is used.

procedures.name: SetReserveToOptional
procedures.doc: Changes the reservation setting from Never to Optional and saves the record.

procedures.name: UpdatePrePaymentAmounts
procedures.doc: Recalculates prepayment amounts to reflect changes in quantity.

procedures.name: ZeroAmountLine
procedures.doc: Determines if the line has a zero amount. It always returns true for a line with a blank type.

procedures.name: FilterLinesWithItemToPlan

procedures.name: InitInsert
procedures.doc: Initializes a new purchase header with a new document number from the number series.

procedures.name: InitRecord
procedures.doc: Initializes a new purchase header with default values.

procedures.name: InitPostingDescription
procedures.doc: Initializes the posting description with formatted document type and number text for the purchase header.

procedures.name: SetStandardCodesMgt
procedures.doc: Sets global StandardCodesMgtGlobal codeunit to a new instance.

procedures.name: AssistEdit
procedures.doc: Opens a page to select related number series for the purchase header and updates the document number with the selected number series.

procedures.name: TestNoSeries
procedures.doc: Checks if the number series for different types of purchase documents are filled in the purchase setup.

procedures.name: GetNoSeriesCode
procedures.doc: Returns the number series code from the purchase setup based on the document type of the purchase header.

procedures.name: TestNoSeriesDate
procedures.doc: Checks if the number series has to be assigned chronologically after various documents are already posted.

procedures.name: ConfirmDeletion
procedures.doc: Opens a confirmation dialog to confirm the deletion of the purchase header. This check is to confirm with the user that gaps will happen in the posted documents if the document is deleted.

procedures.name: GetVend
procedures.doc: Updates the global Vend record if it doesn't already match the provided vendor no.

procedures.name: GetStatusStyleText
procedures.doc: Returns document status field style expression based on the status of the purchase header.

procedures.name: PurchLinesExist
procedures.doc: Checks if the purchase lines exists for purchase header.

procedures.name: RecreatePurchLines
procedures.doc: Recreates purchase lines for a purchase document when the provided field in the purchase header is changed.

procedures.name: StorePurchCommentLineToTemp
procedures.doc: Inserts existing purchase comment lines into a temporary record.

procedures.name: RestorePurchCommentLine
procedures.doc: Inserts purchase comment lines for the purchase line of the document from the provided temporary purchase comment line record set.

procedures.name: TransferSavedFieldsDropShipment
procedures.doc: Updates certain fields from a source purchase line to a destination purchase line for a drop shipment scenario. It also updates the corresponding sales order line.

procedures.name: MessageIfPurchLinesExist
procedures.doc: Displays a message if purchase lines exist for the purchase header and the changed field was not updated on the lines.

procedures.name: PriceMessageIfPurchLinesExist
procedures.doc: Displays a message to the user if there are existing purchase lines and a provided field in the purchase header has been changed, which might affect the prices and discounts on the purchase lines.

procedures.name: UpdateCurrencyFactor
procedures.doc: Updates currency factor on the purchase header and recreates purchase lines if the currency code has changed.

procedures.name: ConfirmCurrencyFactorUpdate
procedures.doc: Updates currency factor on the purchase header if confirmed by the user.

procedures.name: GetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global flag HideValidationDialog.

procedures.name: SetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global flag HideValidationDialog.

procedures.name: UpdateLocationCode
procedures.doc: Updates the location code with the specified location code. If it's empty, it takes location code from user setup management. Otherwise, validates the location code with the provided value.

procedures.name: UpdatePurchLines
procedures.doc: Updates purchase lines if the provided field in the purchase header is changed and the confirmation is accepted.

procedures.name: UpdatePurchLinesByFieldNo
procedures.doc: Updates purchase lines if the provided field in the purchase header is changed.

procedures.name: ConfirmReservationDateConflict
procedures.doc: Checks if reservation entry exists for the purchase header and opens a confirmation dialog if the user wants to continue. These reservations will be canceled if a date conflict is caused by the changed field. This is an overload that sets ChangedFieldNo to 0.

procedures.name: ConfirmReservationDateConflict
procedures.doc: Checks if reservation entry exists for the purchase header and opens a confirmation dialog if the user wants to continue. These reservations will be canceled if a date conflict is caused by the changed field.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimensions for the purchase header based on the provided default dimension sources.

procedures.name: CouldDimensionsBeKept
procedures.doc: Determines if the dimensions of a purchase header could be kept the same when certain fields are changed.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Verifies whether the provided shortcut dimension code and value are valid.

procedures.name: ReceivedPurchLinesExist
procedures.doc: Determines if purchase lines that are already received exist.

procedures.name: ReturnShipmentExist
procedures.doc: Determines if purchase lines that are already returned exist.

procedures.name: UpdateShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Updates the shipping address details of a purchase header based on the location or the company information.

procedures.name: UpdateBuyFromCont
procedures.doc: Updates the buy-from contact details of a purchase header based on the provided vendor number.

procedures.name: CreateInvtPutAwayPick
procedures.doc: Creates inventory put-away, pick, or movement documents for a released purchase document.

procedures.name: ShowDocDim
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing dimensions for the purchase header. If dimensions are changed, they're updated on the purchase lines as well.

procedures.name: UpdateAllLineDim
procedures.doc: Updates the dimensions of purchase lines in a purchase document when the dimensions of the purchase header are changed.

procedures.name: SetAmountToApply
procedures.doc: Updates amount to apply value of the vendor ledger entry based on the applies-to document number and the vendor number.

procedures.name: SetShipToForSpecOrder
procedures.doc: Updates the ship-to information of a purchase header based on the associated location. If location code is not specified in the purchase header, the information is updated from company information.

procedures.name: GetPstdDocLinesToReverse
procedures.doc: Opens a page with posted document lines that can be reversed. After the user selects the lines, they're copied to the current document.

procedures.name: SetSecurityFilterOnRespCenter
procedures.doc: Filters the purchase header for responsibility center set in the user setup or company information. The filter is set in filter group 2 and is hidden from the user.

procedures.name: CalcInvDiscForHeader
procedures.doc: Calculates invoice discount for a purchase header if calculate invoice discount is enabled in the purchase setup.

procedures.name: AddShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Updates ship-to information of a purchase header based on the provided sales header. If purchase lines exist, it compares the shipping information between the purchase and sales header and throws an error in case of a mismatch.

procedures.name: DropShptOrderExists
procedures.doc: Determines if the drop shipment order exists.

procedures.name: SpecialOrderExists
procedures.doc: Determines if the special order exist.

procedures.name: QtyToReceiveIsZero
procedures.doc: Determines if there's anything left to receive for the document.

procedures.name: IsApprovedForPosting
procedures.doc: Determines if a purchase document is approved for posting. For orders, it additionally checks if the payment and prepayment conditions are met.

procedures.name: IsApprovedForPostingBatch
procedures.doc: Determines if a purchase document is approved for posting. It checks if the prepayment and payment conditions are met.

procedures.name: IsTotalValid
procedures.doc: Determines if the total amount including VAT of an incoming document matches the total amount including VAT of the purchase document.

procedures.name: SendToPosting
procedures.doc: Posts a purchase document by running the provided codeunit if the document is approved for posting.

procedures.name: CancelBackgroundPosting
procedures.doc: Cancels a background posting job for a purchase document.

procedures.name: GetDocTypeTxt
procedures.doc: Retrieves the full document type name based on the purchase header document type.

procedures.name: AddSpecialOrderToAddress
procedures.doc: Adds the shipping information from a special order. If lines exist, it compares the current shipping information with the information on the special order and throws an error if there's a mismatch.

procedures.name: InvoicedLineExists
procedures.doc: Returns true or false whether any line has "Quantity Invoiced" not 0.

procedures.name: CreateDimSetForPrepmtAccDefaultDim
procedures.doc: Creates a dimension set for the purchase lines that have a prepayment amount.

procedures.name: TransferItemChargeAssgntPurchToTemp
procedures.doc: Transfers item charge assignments to the temporary record set and deletes them from the original record.

procedures.name: PrepareOpeningDocumentStatistics
procedures.doc: Prepares the opening document statistics for a purchase document. It checks the user's permissions, calculates the invoice discount, creates a dimension set for order documents, and commits any changes made.

attributes.name: Obsolete
args: 'The statistics action will be replaced with the PurchaseOrderStatistics action. The new action uses RunObject and does not run the action trigger. Use a page extension to modify the behaviour.'

obsolete.reason: The statistics action will be replaced with the PurchaseOrderStatistics action. The new action uses RunObject and does not run the action trigger. Use a page extension to modify the behaviour.

procedures.name: CheckPurchasePostRestrictions
procedures.doc: Triggers the OnCheckPurchasePostRestrictions event to check any additional restrictions before releasing a purchase document.

procedures.name: CheckPurchaseReleaseRestrictions
procedures.doc: Checks any restrictions before releasing a purchase document.

procedures.name: SetStatus
procedures.doc: Sets the status of a purchase document.

procedures.name: TriggerOnAfterPostPurchaseDoc
procedures.doc: Triggers an event after a purchase document is posted.

procedures.name: DeferralHeadersExist
procedures.doc: Determines if deferral header exists for a purchase document.

procedures.name: GetUpdatedFieldCaption
procedures.doc: Returns field caption for the provided field number.

procedures.name: IsCreditDocType
procedures.doc: Determines if the document type is a credit document.

procedures.name: SetBuyFromVendorFromFilter
procedures.doc: Updates the buy-from vendor no. of a purchase header based on a single-value filter applied to the buy-from vendor no. field.

procedures.name: CopyBuyFromVendorFilter
procedures.doc: Moves the filter on buy-from vendor no. from the current filter group to filter group 2.

procedures.name: HasBuyFromAddress
procedures.doc: Determines if purchase header has buy-from information.

procedures.name: HasShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Determines if purchase header has ship-to information.

procedures.name: HasPayToAddress
procedures.doc: Determines if purchase header has pay-to information.

procedures.name: HasItemChargeAssignment
procedures.doc: Determines if the purchase header has any item charge assignments.

procedures.name: SetShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Sets the ship-to information for a purchase document from the provided parameters.

procedures.name: ShouldSearchForVendorByName
procedures.doc: Determines whether a search for a vendor should be performed by name for the provided vendor no.

procedures.name: CopyBuyFromAddressToPayToAddress
procedures.doc: Copies the buy-from information to pay-to information for a purchase document if the pay-to vendor no. is the same as the buy-from vendor no.

procedures.name: ConfirmCloseUnposted
procedures.doc: Raises a dialog to confirm closing a page if unposted lines exist.

procedures.name: InitFromPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Initializes a purchase header from the provided purchase header.

procedures.name: BuyfromContactLookup
procedures.doc: Opens a contact lookup page and validates the buy-from contact no. field with the selected contact.

procedures.name: SendRecords
procedures.doc: Sends selected purchase document reports to the vendors. Before this procedure is called, purchase documents are selected on the page and then selection filter is used to filter the selected documents.

procedures.name: PrintRecords
procedures.doc: Prints selected purchase document reports. Before this procedure is called, purchase documents are selected on the page and then selection filter is used to filter the selected documents.

procedures.name: SendProfile
procedures.doc: Sends a purchase order document report with a specified document sending profile.

procedures.name: GetUserSetupPurchaserCode
procedures.doc: Retrieves the salesperson/purchaser code of the current user from the user setup.

procedures.name: OnAfterValidateBuyFromVendorNo
procedures.doc: Removes the filter from buy-from vendor no. if the number has changed Updates remittance address for the record if the default remit address for the vendor exists.

procedures.name: SelectDefaultRemitAddress
procedures.doc: Sets the default remittance address on the provided purchase header.

procedures.name: BatchConfirmUpdateDeferralDate
procedures.doc: Raises a confirmation to update the deferral schedules on the lines to reflect the changed dates. If user confirms the update, the purchase lines are updated.

procedures.name: SetAllowSelectNoSeries
procedures.doc: Sets the global flag SelectNoSeriesAllowed to true.

procedures.name: RecallModifyAddressNotification
procedures.doc: Recalls a sent notification for the provided notification GUID.

procedures.name: GetModifyVendorAddressNotificationId
procedures.doc: Returns a GUID for a notification that warns the user if the buy-from address on purchase documents is different from the vendor's existing address.

procedures.name: GetModifyPayToVendorAddressNotificationId
procedures.doc: Returns a GUID for a notification that warns if the pay-to address on purchase documents is different from the vendor's existing address.

procedures.name: GetShowExternalDocAlreadyExistNotificationId
procedures.doc: Returns a GUID for a notification that warns if purchase document with same external document number already exists.

procedures.name: GetLineInvoiceDiscountResetNotificationId
procedures.doc: Returns a GUID for a notification that warns if the invoice discount amount for the purchase line record has been reset.

procedures.name: GetWarnWhenZeroQuantityPurchaseLinePosting
procedures.doc: Returns a GUID for a notification that warns before posting lines on purchase documents where quantity is 0.

procedures.name: SetModifyVendorAddressNotificationDefaultState
procedures.doc: Inserts the default notification to warn if the buy-from address on purchase documents is different from the vendor's existing address.

procedures.name: SetModifyPayToVendorAddressNotificationDefaultState
procedures.doc: Inserts the default notification to warn if pay-to address on purchase documents is different from the vendor's existing address.

procedures.name: SetShowExternalDocAlreadyExistNotificationDefaultState
procedures.doc: Inserts the default notification to warn if purchase document with same external document number already exists.

procedures.name: DontNotifyCurrentUserAgain
procedures.doc: Disables a specified notification for the current user.

procedures.name: SetWarnZeroQuantityPurchasePosting
procedures.doc: Inserts the default notification to warn before posting lines on purchase documents where quantity is 0.

procedures.name: FindPostedDocumentWithSameExternalDocNo
procedures.doc: Finds a posted purchase document for the provided external document no.

procedures.name: FilterPartialReceived
procedures.doc: Applies the filter for the headers that have received lines.

procedures.name: FilterPartialInvoiced
procedures.doc: Applies the filter for the headers that have partially invoiced lines.

procedures.name: IsDocAlreadyExistNotificationEnabled
procedures.doc: Determines if the notification which warns if purchase document with same external document number already exists is enabled.

procedures.name: ShipToAddressEqualsCompanyShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Determines if the ship-to information in the purchase header record matches the ship-to information in the company information.

procedures.name: BuyFromAddressEqualsShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Determines if ship-to information is equal to the buy-from information in the purchase header record.

procedures.name: BuyFromAddressEqualsPayToAddress
procedures.doc: Determines if buy-from information is equal to the pay-to information in the purchase header record.

procedures.name: ValidatePurchaserOnPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Checks if the document can be created/posted depending on the privacy blocked of the purchaser.

procedures.name: CanCalculateTax
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global variable SkipTaxCalculation.

procedures.name: SetSkipTaxCalulation
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable SkipTaxCalculation.

procedures.name: ValidateEmptySellToCustomerAndLocation

procedures.name: TestStatusIsNotReleased

procedures.name: DeletePurchCommentLines

procedures.doc: Delets all lines in the provided record set.

procedures.name: SetReplaceDocumentDate

procedures.name: GetUseDate
procedures.doc: Returns the posting date from purchase header if it's available, otherwise it returns the current work date.

procedures.name: InitOutstanding
procedures.doc: Initializes outstanding quantities and amounts of the purchase line.

procedures.name: InitOutstandingAmount
procedures.doc: Initializes the outstanding amounts of the purchase line.

procedures.name: InitQtyToReceive
procedures.doc: Initializes the quantity to receive and quantity to invoice of the purchase line.

procedures.name: InitQtyToShip
procedures.doc: Initializes the return quantity to ship and quantity to invoice of the purchase line.

procedures.name: InitQtyToInvoice
procedures.doc: Initializes the quantity to invoice and vat of the purchase line. Calculates invoice disc. amount to invoice.

procedures.name: MaxQtyToInvoice
procedures.doc: Calculates maximum quantity that can be invoiced for the purchase line.

procedures.name: MaxQtyToInvoiceBase
procedures.doc: Calculates maximum quantity (base) that can be invoiced for the purchase line.

procedures.name: MaxQtyToReceiveBase
procedures.doc: Returns the maximum quantity (base) that can be received for a given quantity.

procedures.name: CalcInvDiscToInvoice
procedures.doc: Calculates and sets the invoices discount amount to invoice and updates vat.

procedures.name: CalcLineAmount
procedures.doc: Calculates the line amount minus inv. discount amount for the purchase line.

procedures.name: SetPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Assigns given purchase header to the global variable and initializes the currency variable.

procedures.name: SetSuppressPurchaseHeaderExistsVerification
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the SuppressPurchaseHeaderExistsVerification variable.

procedures.name: GetPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Retrieves the global purchase header for the current purchase line.

procedures.name: GetPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Gets the purchase header and currency for the current purchase line.

procedures.name: GetItem
procedures.doc: Returns the item record.

procedures.name: GetRemainingQty
procedures.doc: Returns remaining unreserved quantity and quantity (base) of the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetReservationQty
procedures.doc: Returns reservation quantities.

procedures.name: GetSourceCaption
procedures.doc: Returns a text that consists of the document type, document no. and line number separated by a space.

procedures.name: SetReservationEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes the reservation entries from the purchase line.

procedures.name: SetReservationFilters
procedures.doc: Filters reservation entry from the purchase line.

procedures.name: ReservEntryExist
procedures.doc: Checks if reservation entry exists for the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountExclVAT
procedures.doc: Returns line amount excluding VAT for the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountInclVAT
procedures.doc: Returns line amount including VAT for the purchase line.

procedures.name: SetHasBeenShown
procedures.doc: Sets the global flag HasBeenShown to true.

procedures.name: IsPriceCalcCalledByField
procedures.doc: Checks if the procedure has been called from the field that was previously planned.

procedures.name: PlanPriceCalcByField
procedures.doc: Sets the field that initiates the price calculation if it is not already set.

procedures.name: ClearFieldCausedPriceCalculation
procedures.doc: Clears the field number that is planned to initiate the price calculation.

procedures.name: UpdateDirectUnitCost
procedures.doc: Updates the direct unit cost of the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetPriceCalculationHandler
procedures.doc: Gets price calculation interface implementation for the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetLineWithPrice
procedures.doc: Gets the default or overridden line with price interface implementation.

procedures.name: CountDiscount
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method CountDiscount. Returns the count of price list lines containing discounts suitable for the purchase line.

procedures.name: CountPrice
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method CountPrice. Returns the count of price list lines containing prices suitable for the purchase line.

procedures.name: DiscountExists
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method IsDiscountExists. Returns true if there are any price list lines containing discounts that are applicable to the purchase line.

procedures.name: PriceExists
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method IsPriceExists. Returns true if there are any price list lines containing prices that are applicable to the purchase line.

procedures.name: PickDiscount
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method PickDiscount. Opens a price list selection to choose discounts suitable for the purchase line. The discounts are assigned to the purchase line after selection.

procedures.name: PickPrice
procedures.doc: Wrapper for price calculation method PickPrice. Opens a price list selection to choose prices suitable for the purchase line. The prices are assigned to the purchase line after selection.

procedures.name: UpdateReferencePriceAndDiscount
procedures.doc: Updates the purchase line's price and discount based on the item reference number.

procedures.name: UpdateUnitCost
procedures.doc: Updates the unit cost of the purchase line.

procedures.name: UpdateAmounts
procedures.doc: Updates line, vat, prepayment and deferral amounts of the purchase line. Initializes outstanding amounts.

procedures.name: UpdateVATAmounts
procedures.doc: Updates amounts, vat amounts and vat procentage of the purchase line.

procedures.name: UpdatePrepmtSetupFields
procedures.doc: Checks prepayment setups and assigns prepayment fields to the purchase line.

procedures.name: UpdateSalesCost
procedures.doc: Updates unit costs of the purchase line.

procedures.name: UpdateUOMQtyPerStockQty
procedures.doc: Updates unit cost, unit price and direct unit cost for the purchase line.

procedures.name: SelectMultipleItems
procedures.doc: Opens a selection of items page. After that, selected items are added to purchase lines.

procedures.name: AddItems
procedures.doc: Adds items to the purchase lines based on a selection filter.

procedures.name: AddItem
procedures.doc: Inserts an item to the purchase line.

procedures.name: TransferExtendedTexts
procedures.doc: Transfers extended texts for the purchase line.

procedures.name: InitNewLine
procedures.doc: Initializes a new purchase line based on the current purchase line.

procedures.name: ShowReservation
procedures.doc: Opens the reservation page for an item in a purchase line.

procedures.name: ShowReservationEntries
procedures.doc: Opens a reservation entries page for the current purchase line.

procedures.name: GetDate
procedures.doc: Returns the posting date from the related purchase header if it's available, otherwise it returns the current work date.

procedures.name: Signed
procedures.doc: Returns a signed decimal value based on the document type of the purchase line.

procedures.name: BlanketOrderLookup
procedures.doc: Opens a page to select blanket order line for the current purchase line. Selected blanket order line information is assigned to the purchase line.

procedures.name: BlockDynamicTracking
procedures.doc: Sets TrackingBlocked flag to the given value. Also sets global Blocked flag of purchase line reserve codeunit.

procedures.name: ShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing dimensions for the purchase line. Upon closing the page, it updates the dimensions on the purcahse line.

procedures.name: OpenItemTrackingLines
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing item tracking lines for the purchase line.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimensions for the purchase line based on the provided default dimension sources.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Verifies whether the provided shortcut dimension code and value are valid.

procedures.name: LookupShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Opens a page for selecting a dimension code, then assigns the selected value to the presented number of the shortcut dimension.

procedures.name: ShowShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Gets an array of shortcut dimension values from the dimensions of the purchase line.

procedures.name: ShowItemChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Opens item charge assignment page, where receipt lines can be selected and additional cost is passed to the selected items.

procedures.name: UpdateItemChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Updates item chage assignment amounts and unit cost for the pruchase line.

procedures.name: DeleteItemChargeAssignment
procedures.doc: Deletes item charge assignments that are applied to purchase document line. The provided parameters filter out item charge assignments to delete.

procedures.name: DeleteChargeChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Deletes item charge assignments for a purchase document line. The provided parameters filter out item charge assignments to delete.

procedures.name: CheckItemChargeAssgnt
procedures.doc: Checks if there are any item charge assignments assigned for the purchase line. If so, it checks if item charge assignment is allowed and if the quantity to assign is zero.

procedures.name: GetSkipTaxCalculation
procedures.doc: Returns the value of global SkipTaxCalculation flag.

procedures.name: SetSkipTaxCalulation
procedures.doc: Sets the global flag SkipTaxCalculation value.

procedures.name: SetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Sets the global HideValidationDialog flag.

procedures.name: GetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Gets the global HideValidationDialog flag.

procedures.name: GetCaptionClass
procedures.doc: Gets a caption class for a field.

procedures.name: TestStatusOpen
procedures.doc: Checks whether the purchase header of the line is open.

procedures.name: GetSuspendedStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global variable StatusCheckSuspended.

procedures.name: SuspendStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable StatusCheckSuspended.

procedures.name: UpdateLeadTimeFields
procedures.doc: Updates Lead Time fields based on the item, location, variant, and vendor for the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetUpdateBasicDates
procedures.doc: Updates the expected receipt date or order date of a purchase line with the corresponding date in the purchase header.

procedures.name: UpdateDates
procedures.doc: Updates purchase line dates based on the promised receipt date or requested receipt date. If both dates are empty, the procedure updates the expected receipt date or oreder date of a purchase line with the corresponding date in the purchase header.

procedures.name: InternalLeadTimeDays
procedures.doc: Returns the total lead time in days for a purchase line, taking into account the safety lead time and inbound whse. handling time. Used to calculate expected receipt date for the purchase line.

procedures.name: UpdateVATOnLines
procedures.doc: Updates VAT and related amounts on all lines of the document.

procedures.name: CalcVATAmountLines
procedures.doc: Calculates the VAT amounts for purchase lines based on the quantity type, and updates the VAT amount lines accordingly.

procedures.name: GetVATAmountLineOfMaxAmt
procedures.doc: Retrieves the VAT amount line corresponding to the purchase line with the highest absolute amount from the set of VAT amount lines.

procedures.name: UpdateWithWarehouseReceive
procedures.doc: Updates the quantities to receive or return for a purchase line based on the document type, quantity, and the location.

procedures.name: CheckWarehouse
procedures.doc: Checks warehouse requirements for a purchase line.

procedures.name: GetOverheadRateFCY
procedures.doc: Calculates the overhead rate in foreign currency for the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetItemTranslation
procedures.doc: Gets the translation of an item's description based on the language code of the purchase header and updates the description fields of the purchase line.

procedures.name: AdjustDateFormula
procedures.doc: Formats a date formula parameter and returns it as a text.

procedures.name: RowID1
procedures.doc: Generates a unique identifier text for a purchase line record which is used for item tracking or drop shipment creation.

procedures.name: IsInbound
procedures.doc: Determines if a purchase line is inbound based on the document type and quantity.

procedures.name: ItemExists
procedures.doc: Checks if an item with a given item number exists in the Item table, but only if the type of the purchase line is item.

procedures.name: FindOrCreateRecordByNo
procedures.doc: Finds or creates a record by a given number and returns the number of the found or created record.

procedures.name: GetAbsMin
procedures.doc: Returns smaller absolute value between QtyToHandle and QtyHandled to ensure that the quantity being handled does not exceed the quantity that is available to handle.

procedures.name: CalcPrepaymentToDeduct
procedures.doc: Updates prepayment amount to deduct of the purchase line.

procedures.name: IsFinalInvoice
procedures.doc: Determines if the current purchase line is the final invoice based on the quantity and quantity to invoice.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountToHandle
procedures.doc: Calculates the line amount to handle for a purchase line based on the quantity to handle.

procedures.name: GetLineAmountToHandleInclPrepmt
procedures.doc: Returns the line amount to handle for a purchase line, including prepayment.

procedures.name: JobTaskIsSet
procedures.doc: Determines if the purchase line has a job task set.

procedures.name: CreateTempJobJnlLine
procedures.doc: Creates a temporary global job journal line based on the purchase line.

procedures.name: UpdateJobPrices
procedures.doc: Updates the job prices in the purchase line record based on the purchase receipt line, or the global job journal line if receipt line doesn't exist.

procedures.name: JobSetCurrencyFactor
procedures.doc: Updates the job currency factor from the temporary global job journal line.

procedures.name: SetUpdateFromVAT
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable UpdateFromVAT.

procedures.name: InitQtyToReceive2
procedures.doc: Initializes the quantity to receive and invoice. Additionally, claculates the invoice discount and prepayment amounts.

procedures.name: SwitchLinesWithErrorsFilter
procedures.doc: Toggles the filter for lines with errors between displaying all lines and only lines with errors.

procedures.name: ClearQtyIfBlank
procedures.doc: Resets qty. to receive values to zero if the document type is an order and the purchase setup has default qty. to receive blank.

procedures.name: ShowLineComments
procedures.doc: Opens a page to show comments for the purchase line.

procedures.name: SetDefaultQuantity
procedures.doc: Resets quantities to receive/return and invoice to zero based on the purchase setup setting for default qty. to receive.

procedures.name: UpdatePrePaymentAmounts
procedures.doc: Recalculates prepayment amounts to reflect changes in quantity.

procedures.name: SetVendorItemNo
procedures.doc: Sets the vendor item number for the purchase line.

procedures.name: ZeroAmountLine
procedures.doc: Determines if the line has a zero amount. It always returns true for a line with a blank type.

procedures.name: FilterLinesWithItemToPlan
procedures.doc: Sets filters on the purchase line for item lines, a specified document type, and various flow filters set in the provided item record.

procedures.name: FindLinesWithItemToPlan
procedures.doc: Retrieves a record set of item purchase lines that match the provided document type and various filters set on the item.

procedures.name: LinesWithItemToPlanExist
procedures.doc: Determines if any purchase lines exist that match the provided document type and various flow filters set on the item.

procedures.name: FilterLinesForReservation
procedures.doc: Sets filters on the purchase line for item lines that match the provided reservation entry.

procedures.name: GetVPGInvRoundAcc
procedures.doc: Retrieves the invoice rounding account number from the vendor posting group associated with the purchase header.

procedures.name: IsReceivedShippedItemDimChanged
procedures.doc: Determines if the dimensions have changed on an already received or shipped item line.

procedures.name: IsServiceCharge
procedures.doc: Checks if the purchase line is a service charge.

procedures.name: ConfirmReceivedShippedItemDimChange
procedures.doc: Raises a confirmation dialog to confirm the change of dimensions on an already received or shipped item line.

procedures.name: InitType
procedures.doc: Initializes the type of the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetDefaultLineType

procedures.name: EmptyLine
procedures.doc: Determines if the general journal line is empty. It is considered empty if account number, amount, and balance account number (if not system created entry) are blank.

procedures.name: GetSkipTaxCalculation
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global flag SkipTaxCalculation.

procedures.name: SetSkipTaxCalulation
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable SkipTaxCalculation.

procedures.name: UpdateLineBalance
procedures.doc: Updates the debit amout, credit amount, balnce and amount fields of a general journal line.

procedures.name: UpdateAmounts
procedures.doc: Updates the debit and credit amounts based on the current line's amount and correction status.

procedures.name: SetUpNewLine
procedures.doc: Initializes a new general journal line with values from the previous general journal line.

procedures.name: InitNewLine
procedures.doc: Initializes a new general journal line.

procedures.name: CheckDocNoOnLines
procedures.doc: Checks the document numbers on general journal lines to ensure correct sequence by the number series in the general journal batch.

procedures.name: RenumberDocumentNo
procedures.doc: Updates the document numbers on general journal lines to ensure correct sequence by the number series in the general journal batch.

procedures.name: RenumberAppliesToID
procedures.doc: Updates the applies to ID in general journal line and related ledger entries.

procedures.name: RenumberAppliesToDocNo
procedures.doc: Updates the applies to document number in general journal lines.

procedures.name: SetCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Sets the currency code from related bank account.

procedures.name: SetCurrencyFactor
procedures.doc: Sets the currency code and currency factor.

procedures.name: GetCurrency
procedures.doc: Sets the global Currency and CurrencyCode variables based on currency information in general journal line.

procedures.name: UpdateSource
procedures.doc: Updates general journal line source type and source number from account or balancing account.

procedures.name: GetFAAddCurrExchRate
procedures.doc: Updates the FA additional currency factor from the FA depreciation book setup.

procedures.name: GetShowCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Returns the currency code for display purposes, substituting default text for empty currency.

procedures.name: ClearCustVendApplnEntry
procedures.doc: Clears customer and vendor application entry fields when account information changes.

procedures.name: CheckFixedCurrency
procedures.doc: Checks if the currency has a fixed exchange rate for the posting date.

procedures.name: SetBankReconciliationCandidatesFilter
procedures.doc: Sets filters on the record to find potential candidates for bank reconciliation matching. Filters for open, non-reversed entries with remaining amounts within the reconciliation date range.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimension set ID from default dimension sources for this bank reconciliation. Builds dimension combinations from bank account defaults and custom dimension sources. Updates all related reconciliation lines when dimensions change.

procedures.name: MatchSingle
procedures.doc: Runs automatic matching process for bank reconciliation lines against bank ledger entries. Uses configurable date range and matching rules to find and apply probable matches.

procedures.name: ImportBankStatement
procedures.doc: Initiates bank statement import process for this reconciliation. Creates reconciliation record and imports statement data using configured import format.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Validates and updates dimension shortcut codes for this reconciliation. Propagates dimension changes to all related reconciliation lines automatically.

procedures.name: ShowDocDim
procedures.doc: Opens dimension maintenance dialog for this reconciliation header. Allows interactive editing of all dimension values and propagates changes to lines.

procedures.name: OpenNewWorksheet
procedures.doc: Creates new payment application batch and opens payment reconciliation worksheet. Prompts user to select bank account and initializes new payment application session.

procedures.name: ImportAndProcessToNewStatement
procedures.doc: Imports bank statement file and processes it into new reconciliation with automatic matching. Handles complete workflow from bank account selection through statement import and processing.

procedures.name: ImportStatement
procedures.doc: Imports statement data from data exchange record into bank reconciliation lines. Processes electronic bank statement data and creates reconciliation line entries.

procedures.name: SelectBankAccountToUse
procedures.doc: Prompts user to select a bank account for payment reconciliation operations. Provides filtered selection based on import format configuration and displays appropriate bank account lists. Handles scenarios with single bank accounts, multiple options, and import format requirements.

procedures.name: DrillDownOnBalanceOnBankAccount
procedures.doc: Opens bank account ledger entries page filtered to show open entries for this reconciliation's bank account. Provides drill-down functionality to view detailed ledger entries that contribute to the bank account balance. Used for balance verification and investigation of unreconciled transactions.

procedures.name: MatchCandidateFilterDate
procedures.doc: Calculates the optimal filter date for finding matching candidates during bank reconciliation. Determines the earliest transaction date from reconciliation lines to establish the date range for searching potential matches in ledger entries and improving matching performance.
